title: /styleguide: the anatomy text puts an unescaped <workspace> in the page HTML
description:
## As asked

Found in the LIN-3958 review (PR #2144) as an out-of-scope finding.

`lib/render-styleguide.js:129` (the Settings piece anatomy for the group note, `purpose`) holds the string `“For everyone in <workspace>”`. The anatomy text is written into the page as HTML without escaping, so `<workspace>` is parsed as an unknown element and the text reads “For everyone in ”.

This happens on base too (it predates LIN-3958). Fix: escape the anatomy text, or write the placeholder as `<workspace>`, and add a unit test that the rendered `/styleguide` contains the literal text “For everyone in <workspace>”.

Found by: review of LIN-3958.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

comments.body: Priority Low: one placeholder in the /styleguide anatomy copy renders as "For everyone in ."; it is cosmetic, on an internal reference page, predates LIN-3958 and does not recur. Type: Bug (rendered text is wrong). Related: LIN-3958 (found in its review).
